title: French quantum computing startup Quobly, which is developing silicon-based quantum computers, raised a €115M Series A led by Bpifrance, SEALSQ, and STMicro (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: French quantum computing startup Quobly, which is developing silicon-based quantum computers, raised a €115M Series A led by Bpifrance, SEALSQ, and STMicro — Quobly has secured Series A funding to advance the industrialisation of its silicon-based quantum computing technology …
